subject: Object-view
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a). "Identifier-1 shall be of class object; the predefined object references SUPER and NULL shall not be specified" (cite.py --check 8.4.3.5.3 -> OK 1)). OoBindObjectView refuses NULL, SUPER and an identifier-1 whose item is not an object reference (a data item, or a function-identifier's temporary) with COBOL2870 naming identifier-1 as written; SELF (class object, 8.4.3.8.3 SR7) is admitted and viewed (golden: INVOKE SELF AS PB1425VA). [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
